baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two seeing verbs at words 2 and 4 govern well-being and a great dominion at words 5-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated perception moves from opening a field to grasping its total condition: bestowed well-being fills an ordered domain whose greatness is extensive rather than a single splendid object.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing supplies the doubled perceptual act and lets the second seeing totalize the opened field.
Pleasant well-being and bestowed favor make the object of sight a lived condition, not merely visible goods.
Kingship and dominion organize the well-being as a realm rather than an unconnected inventory.
Magnitude opposite smallness expands the realm's scale and reach.

changed_reading.before: The observer sees luxurious things and a large kingdom.
changed_reading.after: The repeated gaze apprehends an all-filling condition of favor and the ordered domain that sustains it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second seeing can be reflective judgment, while the dominion noun carries cohesion, mainstay, and the adjective's chief bulk.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can move from sight to diagnosis: the habitat agrees with its inhabitants because its dominion is the cohesive support and chief structure of the whole scene.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment turns the repeated seeing from reception of surfaces into appraisal of how the scene works.
A place agreeing with its occupant supplies the environmental fit expressed as well-being.
Strength and cohesion make dominion the binding integrity of the environment.
The mainstay of an affair makes dominion the support on which the visible ease depends.
The chief share or bulk makes greatness systemic predominance rather than sheer dimensions.

changed_reading.before: Great dominion means a very large possession.
changed_reading.after: Great dominion is the habitat's predominant, cohesive mainstay, recognized through reflective sight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant mapping of the seeing root to root_000615 places quenching and water provisioning beside a dominion branch in which water controls the affair.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch constellation lets sight resonate with satiation: well-being is a quenched state, and dominion is the resource order able to secure and deliver water at great scale.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst supply the form-distant satiation latent in the act of seeing.
Bringing and carrying water turns the latent satiation into a provisioning process.
Bestowed pleasant well-being names the condition produced by reliable provisioning.
Water as control of a group's affair makes resource security the concrete mechanism of dominion.
Magnitude scales the water-secured order beyond a private drink or isolated spring.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents visual luxury and political power.
changed_reading.after: The verse can faintly present a quenched commonwealth whose greatness lies in water-secured provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repeated seeing, visible appearance, dominion, and self-magnifying greatness permit a staged-display branch before context is considered.
baseline_models.mechanism: The realm could initially appear as power arranged to be witnessed: the observer's gaze is the audience through which dominion becomes socially magnified.

activation_trace.role: Showing off before people makes the doubled gaze a possible audience for status display.
Visible appearance supplies the polished surface through which the display is recognized.
Kingship and dominion provide the status being displayed.
Grandeur and self-magnification make greatness potentially theatrical rather than merely quantitative.

changed_reading.before: The sight neutrally reports a realm's abundance.
changed_reading.after: The sight may initially register a deliberately visible spectacle of magnified sovereign status.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created visual capacity is exercised in a sequence where moving figures are first estimated as scattered gleaming points; the immediately repeated seeing in the focus ayah then synthesizes those particulars into the abstract recognition of well-being and dominion.

activation_trace.role: Heart-insight enlarges created vision from optical reception into recognition of significance.
Eye-or-insight seeing starts the adjacent comparison and hands its perceptual frame directly to the focus ayah.
Supposition marks the pearl image as an observer's provisional estimate rather than the final apprehension.
Gleaming supplies the bright visual points that catch the observer before systemic recognition.
Casting things separately supplies distributed particulars that the next repeated gaze can integrate.
Repeated eye-or-insight seeing performs the shift from local impressions to a whole-field apprehension.
Pleasant well-being is the first abstract condition inferred from the distributed scene.
Dominion is the second-order organization recognized behind the many visible points.

structural_cues: The conditional sight clause in 76:19 is immediately followed by another conditional sight clause in 76:20, where the seeing verb occurs twice.
The sequence moves from a comparison applied to visible persons in 76:19 to abstract accusatives in 76:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: created vision, provisional reckoning, gleaming scattering, and immediate verbal repetition. Reader inference: the second sight integrates the distributed points into a systemic condition. Live alternative: 76:20 may simply add a fresh panoramic description without correcting or completing 76:19.

changed_reading.before: The gaze sees a large collection of paradisal objects.
changed_reading.after: The gaze moves from scattered visual signals to recognition of the invisible order and well-being those signals instantiate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearness, facilitated fruit, circulating service, and fitted measure define greatness by responsiveness: the realm continuously brings shade, food, vessels, and attendants within usable reach.

activation_trace.role: Nearness makes the environment approach its occupants instead of making them traverse its scale.
Facilitation after difficulty turns abundance into effortless availability.
Near fruit clusters make nourishment materially reachable rather than merely decorative.
Circulation around recipients supplies a delivery loop for the realm's goods.
Fit to proper measure makes provision calibrated to recipients rather than indiscriminately excessive.
A place agreeing with its occupant names the result of proximity, ease, and fit.
The mainstay of an affair turns dominion into the support system coordinating responsive provision.
The chief bulk makes responsive service the predominant character of the realm.

structural_cues: From 76:14 through 76:19, shade and fruit are brought near, vessels and attendants circulate, and containers are fitted by measure.
The focus ayah follows this service sequence before the next ayah specifies clothing, ornament, and drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated approach, facilitation, circulation, and proportion. Reader inference: these actions define the criterion by which the dominion is called great. Live alternative: they may remain separate courtly amenities while greatness refers only to size or rank.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is distance, scale, and accumulated luxury.
changed_reading.after: Greatness is an occupant-responsive order in which distance, difficulty, and mismatch have been engineered away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water proceeds from allotted drinking through a flowing source and opened channels to a Lord-given, purifying drink; this makes the focus ayah's split quenching branch and water-control branch function as a complete provisioning regime.

activation_trace.role: A share of water turns drinking into allocation within a common provision system.
A source of flowing water supplies the hydrological origin of the system.
Wide splitting and emission make the source actively channelable rather than fixed in one place.
A watering share and its channel join personal satiation to managed distribution.
A medium that purifies others makes the culminating drink restorative as well as plentiful.
Quenching gives the split seeing root a result repeatedly enacted by the context's drinks.
Water carrying links the split root to the context's movement from source to recipient.
Water as control of the affair defines dominion as reliable command of the life-supporting resource.
Bestowed well-being is the human condition produced by the water network.

structural_cues: Drinking and a channelable spring appear in 76:5-6; vessels, another drink, and a named spring recur in 76:15-18; the Lord gives drink in 76:21.
Agency shifts from servants opening the source in 76:6 to the Lord watering the recipients in 76:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recurrent drinks, flowing source, channel opening, watering, purification, and a split focus-root inventory containing quenching. Reader inference: these form the resource infrastructure of dominion. Live alternative: water is one repeated luxury image and the split mapping is only a formal lexical accident.

changed_reading.before: The great dominion contains abundant drinks.
changed_reading.after: The great dominion is partly constituted by a source-to-recipient water regime that secures quenching, distribution, and purification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who feed others refuse repayment or gratitude, yet their action is answered, their striving acknowledged, and the Lord directly provides; dominion is therefore a non-extractive countergift under Lordly sovereignty rather than autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Recognition of favor makes the recipients' striving acknowledged even though they demanded no human gratitude.
Feeding another supplies the outward, non-extractive action later answered by provision.
Will and intention mark the explicit refusal to seek a return from recipients.
Response to an act names the compensation they decline to extract from those they feed.
The same act-response branch returns after the focus ayah as the declared source of the gift.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the provider whose gift underlies the visible dominion.
Work, earning, and responsible action preserve the recipients' acknowledged agency within the gift.
Bestowed favor makes the seen well-being a gift rather than self-generated wealth.
Ownership and disposal pose the question of possession that the giver-recipient sequence revises.
Rank and honor make greatness the elevation of formerly self-effacing givers.

structural_cues: In 76:9 the feeders reject reward and thanks; 76:12 and 76:22 frame the garden sequence as an answering reward.
Immediately after the focus ayah, 76:21 names the Lord as direct giver of drink, and 76:22 names the recipients' striving as appreciated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: refusal of human return, later divine response, direct Lordly provision, and acknowledged striving. Reader inference: the realm embodies non-extractive reciprocity and delegated honor. Live alternative: the relation is ordinary recompense, with dominion simply one item paid out.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants independently possess a magnificent realm.
changed_reading.after: Their honored dominion is a bestowed countergift that answers generosity without reproducing the extraction they refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment to what is immediate hides a weighty day behind the perceiver; against that reversal, the focus ayah's great dominion becomes the substantial reality disclosed when reflective sight reaches beyond the near surface.

activation_trace.role: Love fixed in the heart supplies the affective attachment that narrows perception to the immediate.
Hastening and bringing forward define the rival horizon of present, readily grasped value.
Covering something behind appearance explains how the consequential horizon can remain perceptually occluded.
Weight opposed to lightness gives the deferred day substance that counters the immediate's attraction.
Reflective judgment makes seeing capable of crossing the bias toward what is merely present.
Dominion supplies the deferred order that must be recognized beyond immediate possession.
Greatness as heaviness or difficulty links the realm's gravity to the weighty day left behind.

structural_cues: 76:27 opposes a loved immediate horizon to a heavy day placed behind those who neglect it.
The focus ayah's deictic 'there' requires an outward reorientation, while 76:27 diagnoses a horizon held behind the subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: immediate attachment, concealment behind appearance, and deferred weight. Reader inference: the focus sight reverses that occlusion and discovers the weight-bearing realm. Live alternative: the heavy day is only punitive contrast, while greatness in 76:20 remains uncomplicated magnitude.

changed_reading.before: Great means visually impressive and very large.
changed_reading.after: Great also means weight-bearing and consequential: a dominion missed by perception captive to immediate surfaces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus movement from created bodily cohesion and possible replacement to bounded willing and admission into mercy relocates greatness in the sovereign capacity that constitutes subjects and governs entry, not only in what recipients possess.

activation_trace.role: Will related to a thing supplies the nested agency by which human willing remains real but not ultimate.
Bringing creation into being locates sovereign capacity beneath the subjects who experience the realm.
Precision, sound construction, and firmness make sovereignty ordered rather than arbitrary force.
Strength and solidity make bodily cohesion an exercised sovereign power.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the capacity to replace subjects rather than depend on them.
Entry into an interior turns the realm into an admitted-to domain with governed boundaries.
Mercy and tenderness define the medium into which sovereign admission occurs.
Kingship and dominion anchor the contextual agency sequence back in the focus noun.
Strength and cohesion connect dominion to the making and binding of embodied subjects.
Magnitude enlarges sovereignty from paradisal estate to creation, agency, replacement, and entry.

structural_cues: After the garden sequence, 76:28-31 joins creation, bodily binding, replacement, nested willing, and admission into mercy.
The inhabitants are recipients in 76:21-22, while the later first-person plural and divine predicates identify the constituting agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: creation, strengthened bodily form, replaceability, nested willing, precise governance, and entry into mercy. Reader inference: these disclose the underlying owner and mechanism of the great dominion. Live alternative: the focus noun denotes the recipients' estate, and 76:28-31 starts a separate exhortative argument.

changed_reading.before: The great dominion belongs straightforwardly to those seen enjoying it.
changed_reading.after: Their visible dominion can simultaneously reveal the greater sovereignty that creates them, sustains their agency, and admits them into mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only spectacle model loses its self-advertising center because the exemplary actors give without seeking gratitude and the next ayah names the Lord as provider; visible grandeur survives, but as disclosed gift rather than recipient-authored ostentation.

activation_trace.role: Recognition and praise are explicitly not demanded, weakening an audience-seeking account of the later display.
Feeding others supplies a social action directed toward need rather than status performance.
Expressed intention makes the rejection of self-interested return part of the actors' posture.
Lordship and ownership relocate authorship of the grandeur in the giver rather than the displayed recipients.
Showing off remains the live focus branch whose self-promotional mechanism is being weakened.
Making something seen preserves a non-ostentatious account of why the gift is nevertheless visibly disclosed.
Dominion remains the grandeur displayed even as its authorship and social purpose shift.
Self-magnification supplies the reading specifically constrained by the context of self-effacing action.

structural_cues: The beneficiaries' earlier speech denies desire for reward or thanks, while 76:21 attributes the climactic drink to their Lord.
The sequence displays honor publicly but never names the honored recipients as the producers of the display.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: refusal of praise and return, visible grandeur, and explicit Lordly provision. Reader inference: display is decentered from recipient self-promotion and becomes manifestation of gift. Live alternative: royal imagery can still perform status even when its beneficiaries were formerly sincere.

changed_reading.before: The repeated gaze is an audience for self-magnifying sovereign spectacle.
changed_reading.after: The grandeur is made visible, but its beneficiaries neither solicit the audience nor author the gift being displayed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface verb is ordinary seeing while quenching comes from the packet's non-dominant mapped root. It remains valid as a packet-authorized split-root activation, is anchored in both occurrences of the focus verb and the water-control branch of the focus dominion noun, and is strongly echoed by the surah's sources and watering. Downstream prose should label it form-distant and exploratory, not present quenching as the verb's direct contextual sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both seeing occurrences participate in the split mapping, while the focus dominion inventory independently names water as control of an affair.

activation_trace.role: Quenching gives the doubled focus verb an exploratory hydration resonance without replacing its ordinary sight syntax.
Water as control of the affair anchors that resonance in a second, independent focus word.
A flowing source supplies the context's concrete water origin.
A watering share and channel complete the context's source-to-recipient echo.

changed_reading.before: Seeing merely reports a water-rich realm.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's exploratory edge, seeing itself resonates with being quenched inside a water-secured dominion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because dominion is usually imagined from a center, throne, or owner, whereas the adjacent image supplies circling figures perceived as scattered points. It remains anchored in the focus noun's cohesion branch and the doubled gaze that recognizes a whole from those points. Downstream prose should offer it as a spatial-political analogy, not claim that the verse rejects centralized kingship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs repeated whole-field sight with a dominion root whose inventory includes strength and cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Circulation around recipients supplies coordinated motion without a named visible center.
Gleaming makes each moving participant a perceptible node in the visual field.
Separate scattering supplies a distributed arrangement rather than a compact royal tableau.
Repeated eye-or-insight seeing integrates the moving points into a recognized whole.
Strength and cohesion make coordinated distribution, rather than a visible throne, the mechanism of dominion.

changed_reading.before: Dominion is visually concentrated in a ruler or central emblem.
changed_reading.after: Dominion may become visible as the cohesion of many circulating, separately gleaming points of service.

strongest_changes: The repeated seeing becomes a synthesis from scattered visible particulars to recognition of a whole condition and order.
Greatness shifts from sheer scale to near, facilitated, measured, and circulating provision.
The split seeing-to-quenching mapping, activated by springs and watering, yields an exploratory water-secured dominion.
The reward sequence recasts possession as a non-extractive countergift under Lordly sovereignty.
The post-focus agency sequence permits the recipients' realm and the sovereignty constituting it to coexist as readings.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made two changes especially visible: the focus ayah closes a long material service sequence rather than standing as an isolated panorama, and its split seeing-root inventory is repeatedly activated by the surah's hydrological chain. The immediate transition from scattered pearls to repeated sight also turns visual abundance into a mechanism of systemic recognition.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar does not by itself settle whether the dominion is chiefly the recipients' possession, the Lord's sovereignty, or a visible overlap of both.
The quenching reading depends on a non-dominant split-root mapping and must remain exploratory despite strong contextual water echoes.
Responsive infrastructure and non-extractive reciprocity may be mechanisms of the realm or cumulative images whose causal integration is reader-supplied.
The focus permits a spectacle branch, but the context weakens without wholly eliminating its status-display potential.
